Simple Linear Regression

1.1 Functional Relationship

The functional relationship is Y=f(X). If the same X is observed, the same Y will result.

1.2 Conditional Expectation

The regression function is E Y∣X .

1.3 The Model

The primary model statement:

Yi = β0 + β1 Xi + ϵi , i=1,…,n

Gauss–Markov error assumptions:

E ϵi =0 , Var ϵi = σ2 , Cov ϵi , ϵj =0 i≠j

1.6 OLS Estimators

Least squares criterion:

Q= ∑ i=1 n Yi − β0 − β1 Xi 2

Closed-form OLS estimators:

β^ 1 = ∑ Xi − X¯ Yi − Y¯ ∑ Xi − X¯ 2 , β^ 0 = Y¯ − β^ 1 X¯

1.7 Error Estimation

Mean Squared Error: MSE = SSE n−2

1.8 Normal Error Model

Maximum Likelihood Estimator for variance: σ^ 2 = SSEn
